## Workload

The workload record shows that grader Elif Sahin completed 861 reads during 435 hours. This represents an average of 2.0 reads per hour. The figures provide a summary of recorded activity for the review period and indicate the volume completed alongside the time available.

## Quality

A total of 57 reads were checked again. The recorded agreement was 66.7 per cent. This comparison provides the quality measure used in the review and records the level of consistency identified between the original grading and the subsequent checks.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. The workload and quality information are presented together to support consideration of both the quantity of reads completed and the outcome of the checks undertaken.
